units.note: Lacuna after τοῦ μὲν διὰ τῶν ὑπομνημάτων is marked [...] in the English.

findings.quote: [he leaves none of them...] [...] [the text breaks off]
findings.problem: The Greek breaks off at οὐδένα τῶν ('none of the ...'). It has no verb, so 'he leaves' is supplied text; the bracket presents a conjecture as if it were a gloss on the Greek.
findings.proposed_fix: none of the [...] [the text breaks off]

units.note: Lacuna at ἀπερίσπαστοι *** παράσχωνται is correctly marked [...]. Ἐφόρῳ προσπεσεῖν ('brought against' / 'occurred to' Ephorus) is ambiguous; the current rendering is defensible.
